stories.quote: GreenRoot has been associated with our firm for more than a year. They specialize in finding meaningful opportunities for Agri Graduates in Maharashtra. With us, they have been supplying good candidates for our Israel Kibbutz Volunteers' Programme — a one-year programme for Agri Graduates and young professionals aged 18–35. They have been meticulous in recruitment and have shown honesty, integrity, and transparency in their approach. We are very pleased to be associated with them.

faq.description: Common questions from Indian agriculture students about international internships with us at GreenRoot.

items.question: Who can apply for international internships?
items.answer: We welcome any agriculture student or recent graduate from India. We accept students from all agricultural disciplines including Agronomy, Horticulture, Plant Breeding, Soil Science, Agricultural Engineering, and more.

items.question: Which countries offer internship opportunities?
items.answer: We currently offer internships in Denmark, Germany, USA, Israel, Australia, Canada, Italy, Portugal, and Peru. We are actively expanding to more countries.

items.question: How do I apply for an international internship?
items.answer: Create your student profile, complete all mandatory details, browse available internships abroad, and submit your application through our platform. Our team will guide you through screening, partner review, visa process, and pre-departure preparation.

items.question: What documents are required to apply?
items.answer: You will need your passport, Aadhaar card, PAN card, academic transcripts, resume/CV, and a statement of purpose. Specific programmes may require additional documents, which we will clearly list for you.

items.question: Are these international internships paid?
items.answer: Yes. We connect students with paid internship programmes that include a monthly stipend or salary. The exact amount varies by country, host organisation, and programme duration — we share full compensation details before you apply.

items.question: Do you help with the visa and travel process?
items.answer: Yes. Once your internship is confirmed, we guide you through visa documentation, application steps, and pre-departure preparation. We work closely with our partner organisations abroad to ensure a smooth transition from India to your host country.
